newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in July -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in July -- MOF.

text.p: Net purchases of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 188.4 billion yen in July after net purchases of 262.4 billion yen a month earlier, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude all bills.
Net buying of Japanese stocks by foreign investors amounted to 1.3 billion yen in July compared with net purchases of 609.8 billion yen in the previous month, the ministry said.
Details of Japanese and foreigners' investments were as follows (in billions of yen):
Foreign stocks: Net Foreign bonds: Net
Japanese stocks: Net Japanese bonds: Net
Figures are rounded and are based on settlements.
